meta.name: bulkpublish-social-scheduling
meta.description: Schedule, publish and analyze social posts across 15 networks via BulkPublish (MCP or REST) — Facebook, Instagram, X, TikTok, YouTube, Threads, Bluesky, Pinterest, Google Business, LinkedIn, Mastodon, Discord, Telegram, Tumblr, Snapchat. Use when the user wants to post, schedule, or bulk-publish to social media, check connected channels, or read post analytics. Always check platform rules before composing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在15个社交平台统一发布、排程并查看帖子数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果运营多平台社媒账号，想一次性规划和发布一周内容
copy.tagline_en: Schedule and publish posts across 15 social networks from one place
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage social accounts on multiple platforms and want to plan content in advance

howto.what: 通过 BulkPublish 在 15 个社交平台发布、定时和统计帖子，支持媒体上传、草稿、审批与各平台规则检查。
howto.when: 当你想在社交平台发帖、定时发布、批量发布，或查看已连接账号和帖子数据时触发。

say.text: 列出我当前已连接的社交平台和账号。
say.note: 会调用 list_channels 获取渠道列表。

say.text: 把这段文字定时到明天早上9点发布到 X 和 Facebook。
say.note: 创建定时任务，按指定时间发布。

say.text: 把这张图片发到 Instagram，并标记为 Reels 视频。

howto.what_en: Publishes, schedules, and analyzes posts across 15 social networks via BulkPublish, with media upload, drafts, approvals, and per-platform rule checks.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user wants to post, schedule, or bulk-publish to social media, check connected channels, or read post analytics.

say_en.text: List my currently connected social platforms and accounts.
say_en.note: Calls list_channels to fetch channel list.

say_en.text: Schedule this text to post to X and Facebook tomorrow at 9 AM.
say_en.note: Creates a scheduled post at the specified time.

say_en.text: Post this image to Instagram and mark it as a Reels video.
